resources.title: Multi-Cloud Governance Control Map Template
resources.description: The blank, fillable five-row/six-column control map Lesson 24's practice lab asks you to build, plus a worked reference row using this course's own Briarcliff Outdoor Gear case study (Lesson 23) so you can see what a completed row looks like before filling in your own. Includes the Lesson 24 self-check table for flagging by-hand policy-drift risk.

resources.title: Cloud Governance Policy Pattern Library
resources.description: Eight real, syntactically valid policy and trust documents compiled from this course's own lessons into one JSON reference: the least-privilege S3 IAM policy, an ExternalId-gated AssumeRole trust policy, the Entra-ID-federated AWS role trust from the Briarcliff case study, a bucket policy with a Deny-insecure-transport statement, an SCP protecting CloudTrail, an SCP enforcing KMS encryption on every S3 upload, a column-restricted Lake Formation grant, and an Azure Policy assignment skeleton pinned to a Deny effect. Meant to be copied and adapted, not used as-is.

resources.title: Cloud Governance Review Checklist (Working Copy)
resources.description: A fillable version of Lesson 25's closing checklist, expanded with Status and Evidence/Owner columns for all 22 items across all five chapters, plus a scoring section for naming your top three gaps. Built to be run against a real environment, not re-read as a summary.
